name: 10 everyday habits you should quit now  From a doctor

lines.ref:
10 everyday habits you should quit now

From a doctor

shots.brief: sitting down at a desk or table and working on a laptop/computer (ref: A man wearing medical scrubs walks up to a desk, pulls out his rolling office chair, sits down, and begins typing on the computer.; tripod)

audit.notes: Easily recreated with any clip of sitting down to work at a desk or laptop. The text hook can be adapted to any profession or niche (e.g. 'From a software engineer', 'From a personal trainer') while putting the full educational list in the caption.
audit.summary: A doctor in scrubs sits down at his desk and types on his computer, with text overlay teasing 10 habits to quit while directing viewers to the caption.
